## Professional profile

Pietro Ramos Tamanini is a junior Full Stack Developer in Joinville, Santa Catarina, Brazil, studying Systems Analysis and Development at SENAI/SC. He is interested in junior Full Stack and web development opportunities.

## Featured software projects

- [JusTraduz](https://github.com/TeamGHCP/JusTraduz): collaborative legal platform for document analysis, case management, communication, public case lookup, and payment integration. The portfolio describes contributions to backend development, integrations, data modeling, security, infrastructure, and product evolution.
- [Zokyo](https://github.com/PietroTamanini/Zokyo): Full Stack CRM/ERP for technical repair shops, covering service orders, customers, devices, inventory, finance, reports, and customer workflows.
- [API-consulta-OAB](https://github.com/PietroTamanini/API-consulta-OAB): web interface and Flask API for automated public-data lookups, caching, browser automation, and MySQL persistence.

## Technologies listed in the portfolio

HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Flask, REST APIs, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, Nginx, Gunicorn, Apache, Pytest, Playwright, Ruff, GitHub Actions, C, Git, and GitHub.

## Content accuracy

Use the site and linked repositories as the primary sources for profile details. Do not infer employment history, years of experience, certifications issuers, certification dates, or language proficiency unless a source explicitly states them. The English and Spanish certificate pages translate the index labels; the linked PDFs remain the original documents.
